title: Moxifloxacin
dek: A later-generation FQ that is Group A in DR-TB (the M in BPaLM) and a first-line companion in HPMZ. gyrA QRDR decides whether the letter is a drug. QTc is the ECG tax.
story: Moxifloxacin 400 mg daily is the usual adult TB dose. It is more active against Mtb in vitro than older FQs and is the FQ in BPaLM and in HPMZ. Levofloxacin is the FQ in many 9-month and BDLLfxC constructs and in 6Lfx TPT. They share the QRDR; they do not share every trial.
Resistance: gyrA D94/A90 class. Do not keep MXF in BPaLM against D94G because “moxi MICs are a bit lower.” Do not put HPMZ on a gyrA mutant.

QTc prolongation stacks with BDQ, CFZ, DLM, ondansetron, methadone. Tendinopathy and CNS irritability are the other host notes. Avoid routine FQ monotherapy of mystery pneumonia in high TB-burden clinics — that is how you paint QRDR mutants before the first Xpert.
deep: M in BPaLM ≠ M in HPMZ’s neighbours. Same 400 mg, different companions, different resistance priors (RR vs DS).
Pregnancy: FQs are used in DR-TB when needed; they are not first-line DS in pregnancy (HRZE).
Children: weight-banded FQ use is real in DR-TB; not a casual ENT prescription.

visual.caption: MXF binds gyrase. QRDR missense blocks the bind. QTc is the host parallel arrow you still have to schedule.

example.title: Community MXF for “pneumonia,” then Ultra RR
example.setup: Two weeks of empiric moxifloxacin for cough, then Ultra RIF detected. tNGS: gyrA WT.

steps.title: You may have missed the QRDR window
steps.body: Two weeks can start a minority. Baseline tNGS WT is not a lifetime warranty — repeat if cultures persist.

steps.title: BPaLM still wants a live M at the start
steps.body: WT QRDR: keep M, watch AF later.

steps.title: Fix the clinic pathway
steps.body: WRD before FQ in a high-TB setting is infection-control for the genome.

example.takeaway: Empiric moxi is a QRDR mutagen when the cough was TB.
